cues.name: hook
cues.text: Could this ribbon really be nine centimetres long? Look closely! It starts at two, not zero.

cues.name: goal
cues.text: Today, let's learn to measure the distance between the marks, rather than just reading the last number.

cues.name: predict
cues.text: Before we calculate, what length do you predict? Follow the spaces with your finger, and keep your answer in mind.

cues.name: trace
cues.text: Now trace from two to nine. Each equal space is one centimetre. We count seven spaces altogether!

cues.name: calculate
cues.text: Nine minus two equals seven. So, the ribbon is seven centimetres long. Did your prediction match?

cues.name: recap
cues.text: Great thinking! Moving the ruler cannot stretch the ribbon. Check the start, count the intervals, then explain your answer.
